theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (B C : ℝ), 0 ≤ B → T.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B → tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ C) → |T ω| ≤ B * C
